calibration.scope: Targeted severity/dependency reassessment of an existing demonstrated finding; unchanged evidence and no new finding.
calibration.standard: A demonstrated invalid derivation closely tied to a core contribution, or material damage to a core conclusion, normally supports Major. Whole-paper failure, loss of the broad research agenda, or changed benchmark scores is not required. Ease of repair and survival of a qualitative rate do not alone determine severity. Peripheral errors may remain Minor; there is no target count of Major findings.
